atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
rangeLen = input(100, "Range Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
predLen = input(30, "Predictability Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
compThresh = input(0.15, "Compression Threshold", 0.02, 0.5, 0.01)
relMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)

baseAtr = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
curRange = high - low
lowestAtrCoil = lowest(baseAtr, coilLen)
coilAtr = baseAtr / max(lowestAtrCoil, 0.000000001)
lowestRange = lowest(curRange, rangeLen)
coilRange = curRange / max(lowestRange, 0.000000001)
loadedCoil = min(coilAtr, coilRange)
isLoaded = loadedCoil < 1.0 + compThresh
highestAtrVov = highest(baseAtr, vovLen)
lowestAtrVov = lowest(baseAtr, vovLen)
vov = (highestAtrVov - lowestAtrVov) / max(lowestAtrVov, 0.000000001)
vovRising = vov > vov[1]
prevClose = close[1]
tr = max(high - low, max(abs(high - prevClose), abs(low - prevClose)))
sumTR = sma(tr, predLen) * predLen
effNum = abs(close - close[predLen])
eff = effNum / max(sumTR, 0.000000001)
coilInv = 2.0 + compThresh - loadedCoil

var loadCount = 0.0
if isLoaded {
    loadCount := loadCount[1] + 1
} else {
    loadCount := 0
}
isRelease = loadCount[1] >= 3 and curRange > relMult * lowestRange and baseAtr > baseAtr[1]
buySig = isLoaded and vovRising and isRelease and close > open and close > high[1]
sellSig = isLoaded and vovRising and isRelease and close < open and close < low[1]

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }

plot(coilInv, "Coil Load (inv)", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(vov, "VoV", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
plot(eff, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 2, "separate")
plot3d(coilInv, "Coil Load 3D", "bars3d", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(eff, "Predictability 3D", "ribbon", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)

sessStartH = input(0, "Session Start Hour", 0, 23, 1)
sessLenH = input(6, "Session Length Hours", 1, 24, 1)
confTF = input("1h", "Confirmation Timeframe")
structLB = input(20, "Structure Lookback Bars 1h", 5, 100, 1)
bufTicks = input(2, "Breakout Buffer Ticks", 0, 20, 1)
stopTicks = input(30, "Hard Stop Ticks", 1, 200, 1)

var sessHigh = 0.0
var sessLow = 0.0
var entryPx = 0.0
var curPos = 0.0

barsPerHour = 12
dayBars = 288
startOff = sessStartH * barsPerHour
sessBars = sessLenH * barsPerHour
endOff = startOff + sessBars
dayPos = bar_index % dayBars
inSession = dayPos >= startOff and dayPos < endOff
newSession = inSession and not inSession[1]

if newSession {
    sessHigh := high
    sessLow := low
}
if inSession {
    sessHigh := high > sessHigh[1] ? high : sessHigh[1]
    sessLow := low < sessLow[1] ? low : sessLow[1]
}
if bar_index == 0 {
    sessHigh := high
    sessLow := low
}

tickSz = 0.1
bufOff = bufTicks * tickSz
stopOff = stopTicks * tickSz

upper = sessHigh + bufOff
lower = sessLow - bufOff

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)

swingHigh = highest(htfHigh, structLB)
swingLow = lowest(htfLow, structLB)
priorSwingHigh = swingHigh[1]
priorSwingLow = swingLow[1]

isBull = htfClose > priorSwingHigh
isBear = htfClose < priorSwingLow

bullBreak = htfClose > priorSwingHigh
bearBreak = htfClose < priorSwingLow
cleanBreak = bullBreak or bearBreak
rangeWidth = swingHigh - swingLow
priorWidth = rangeWidth[1]
widthExpand = rangeWidth > priorWidth
noWickBull = bullBreak and htfLow > priorSwingHigh
noWickBear = bearBreak and htfHigh < priorSwingLow
noWick = noWickBull or noWickBear
qBreak = cleanBreak ? 50 : 0
qWidth = widthExpand ? 25 : 0
qWick = noWick ? 25 : 0
quality = qBreak + qWidth + qWick
confScore = quality / 100

buySig = crossover(close, upper) and isBull and inSession
sellSig = crossunder(close, lower) and isBear and inSession

longStopPx = entryPx - stopOff
shortStopPx = entryPx + stopOff
stopHitLong = curPos == 1 and low <= longStopPx
stopHitShort = curPos == -1 and high >= shortStopPx
backInsideLong = crossunder(close, sessHigh) and curPos == 1
backInsideShort = crossover(close, sessLow) and curPos == -1
exitLongSig = backInsideLong or stopHitLong
exitShortSig = backInsideShort or stopHitShort

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(stopOff, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    curPos := 1
    entryPx := close
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(stopOff, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    curPos := -1
    entryPx := close
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLongSig {
    model.longExit("siege")
    model.exit("siege")
    curPos := 0
}
if exitShortSig {
    model.shortExit("siege")
    model.exit("siege")
    curPos := 0
}

sessHighPlot = inSession ? sessHigh : close
sessLowPlot = inSession ? sessLow : close
stopPlot = curPos == 1 ? longStopPx : curPos == -1 ? shortStopPx : close
plot(sessHighPlot, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLowPlot, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(stopPlot, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
